title: US Loses Measles-Free Status Following Record Outbreak
subtitle: Public health experts express alarm as the nation faces its worst measles crisis in decades.

summary.en: The United States has officially lost its long-held measles-free status after a year of continuous virus spread. International health authorities confirmed the change following a surge of over 5,400 cases and 10 deaths. Experts describe the situation as a national embarrassment and a significant step backward for public health. While the government promises to work toward regaining the status, critics have called for changes in leadership. The outbreak highlights the ongoing challenge of maintaining high vaccination rates across the country.
summary.zh: 美國在經歷了一年病毒持續傳播後，已正式失去維持已久的無麻疹國家地位。國際衛生當局在病例數激增至超過五千四百例並造成十人死亡後，證實了這項變更。專家形容此情況為國家之恥，也是公共衛生的一大倒退。儘管政府承諾將努力恢復該地位，批評者已要求更換領導層。此次疫情凸顯了在全國維持高疫苗接種率所面臨的持續挑戰。

paragraphs.en: The United States has officially lost its measles-free status, a major public health designation that the country held for 26 years. The Pan American Health Organization (PAHO), a regional branch of the World Health Organization, confirmed the decision on Tuesday. This status is given to countries where the virus is no longer spreading continuously. The loss follows a year of rising cases, with more than 5,400 infections and 10 deaths reported by state health authorities. According to The Guardian, this is the worst measles outbreak in the country since 1991.
paragraphs.zh: 美國已正式失去「無麻疹國家」的地位，這是一項該國維持了二十六年的重要公共衛生認證。世界衛生組織（World Health Organization）的區域分支機構泛美衛生組織（Pan American Health Organization, PAHO）於週二證實了這項決定。此地位授予那些病毒已不再持續傳播的國家。在失去此地位之前，該國經歷了病例數攀升的一年，州衛生當局通報了超過五千四百起感染病例及十起死亡案例。根據《衛報》（The Guardian）報導，這是該國自一九九一年以來最嚴重的麻疹疫情。

paragraphs.en: For many medical professionals, the loss of this status is both sad and frustrating. Dr. Jon Andrus, who chaired the PAHO advisory committee that recommended the change, described the decision as emotional. He noted that public health experts have worked for decades to keep the virus under control. The US, once considered a global leader in disease prevention, now joins other nations that have also lost their elimination status. The Guardian reports that Bolivia and Mexico have also lost their status, marking a difficult time for the entire region.
paragraphs.zh: 對許多醫療專業人員而言，失去這項地位既令人難過又感到挫折。曾擔任泛美衛生組織諮詢委員會主席並建議做出此項變更的安德魯斯醫師（Dr. Jon Andrus）形容這項決定令人感傷。他指出，公共衛生專家數十年來致力於控制該病毒。美國曾被視為全球疾病預防的領頭羊，如今卻與其他同樣失去消除狀態的國家並列。據《衛報》報導，玻利維亞與墨西哥也失去了此地位，這對整個區域而言是一個艱難的時刻。

paragraphs.en: Ars Technica reports that the decision was widely expected by experts for months. The data used to make this decision came from an independent group of experts called the National Sustainability Committee (NSC). They reviewed information collected since January 2025. While the current number of cases is very high, experts point out that the loss of status was actually determined by earlier data trends. The situation has now turned into a runaway epidemic, with a large outbreak in Pennsylvania alone accounting for over 1,500 of the total cases.
paragraphs.zh: 根據科技新聞網站 Ars Technica 報導，專家們數月來普遍預期會做出這項決定。用於做出此決定的數據來自一個名為國家永續委員會（National Sustainability Committee, NSC）的獨立專家小組。他們審查了自二零二五年一月以來收集的資訊。雖然目前的病例數非常高，但專家指出，失去地位的決定實際上是由更早期的數據趨勢所判定。目前情況已演變成失控的流行病，僅賓夕法尼亞州的一場大規模疫情就佔了總病例數的一千五百多例。

paragraphs.en: Measles is known as one of the most infectious diseases in the world. It can be very dangerous, especially for those who are not vaccinated. Health officials state that the infection causes one to three deaths for every 1,000 unvaccinated people and leads to hospital stays for up to one in five patients. Public health workers emphasize that vaccination is one of the most effective ways to protect human life, similar to the importance of clean water and good sanitation.
paragraphs.zh: 麻疹被公認為世界上最具傳染性的疾病之一。它可能非常危險，特別是對未接種疫苗的人而言。衛生官員表示，每千名未接種疫苗的感染者中，會導致一至三人死亡，且高達五分之一的患者需要住院治療。公共衛生工作者強調，接種疫苗是保護生命最有效的方法之一，其重要性等同於潔淨水源與良好的衛生設施。

paragraphs.en: The reaction from political leaders has been sharp. Many have criticized the current administration for its handling of the crisis. According to The Guardian, some senators have called for the resignation of Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr., describing his time in office as a series of failures. Critics point to his history of sharing misinformation about the MMR vaccine—a combination vaccine that protects against measles, mumps, and rubella—as a reason for the decline in public trust. In contrast, Kennedy has stated that he will continue to recommend the vaccine as the best way to prevent the disease. He promised that the Department of Health and Human Services is working to close vaccination gaps and rebuild trust with families.
paragraphs.zh: 政治領袖的反應相當激烈。許多人批評現任政府處理這場危機的方式。根據《衛報》報導，一些參議員要求衛生部長小羅伯特·甘迺迪（Robert F. Kennedy Jr.）辭職，稱其任期是一連串的失敗。批評者指出，他過去曾散布關於麻疹、腮腺炎及德國麻疹混合疫苗（MMR vaccine）的錯誤資訊，這是導致公眾信任度下降的原因。相較之下，甘迺迪表示他將繼續推薦接種該疫苗，認為這是預防疾病的最佳途徑。他承諾衛生與公共服務部正致力於縮小疫苗接種差距，並重建與家庭之間的信任。

paragraphs.en: Despite the current challenges, officials say that the loss of status does not come with official penalties or travel restrictions. Instead, it serves as a wake-up call for the country. The goal now is to address the spread of the virus through better communication and increased access to vaccines. As the country moves forward, the focus remains on working with trusted healthcare providers and community leaders to limit the spread of the disease. The path to regaining measles-free status will require a renewed commitment to public health and a focus on ensuring that all Americans have access to the protection that vaccines provide.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管面臨當前的挑戰，官員表示失去此地位並不會帶來官方懲罰或旅行限制。相反地，這對國家而言是一個警鐘。目前的目標是透過更好的溝通與增加疫苗取得管道來應對病毒傳播。隨著國家向前邁進，重點仍放在與值得信賴的醫療提供者及社區領袖合作，以限制疾病擴散。重獲無麻疹地位的道路，將需要對公共衛生做出新的承諾，並確保所有美國人都能獲得疫苗所提供的保護。

keyTerms.definitionEn: Happening or spreading in an uncontrolled or rapid way.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作名詞（逃跑者），這裡作形容詞修飾疫情。文中：The situation has now turned into a runaway epidemic, with a large outbreak in Pennsylvania alone accounting for over 1,500 of the total cases.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Strong, severe, or critical in tone.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 強烈的、尖銳的（指批評或反應）。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作形容詞（鋒利的），這裡形容政治反應強烈。文中：The reaction from political leaders has been sharp.

keyTerms.definitionEn: An event that serves as a warning and makes people realize they need to take action.
keyTerms.noteZh: 字面上是「叫醒電話」，這裡指促使人們採取行動的警告。文中：Instead, it serves as a wake-up call for the country.

quiz.question: What was the primary basis for the decision to revoke the United States' measles-free status?

options.A: A sudden spike in cases reported in Pennsylvania in early 2025.
options.B: Long-term data trends analyzed by an independent committee of experts.
options.C: The resignation of the Health Secretary due to public health failures.
options.D: A formal request from the World Health Organization to impose travel restrictions.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第三段，雖然賓州有大規模疫情，但專家指出撤銷地位的決定是基於「較早期的數據趨勢」（earlier data trends），並由獨立的國家永續委員會（NSC）進行審查。選項 A 雖然提到賓州病例，但那是整體疫情的一部分而非決策的主要依據。選項 C 與撤銷地位的決策過程無關。選項 D 錯誤，因為文章最後一段明確提到該決定並不伴隨旅行限制。

quiz.question: Based on the article, what is the likely connection between public trust and the current measles crisis?

options.A: Public trust has increased because the government is now mandating the MMR vaccine.
options.B: The crisis is primarily caused by a lack of clean water and poor sanitation in major cities.
options.C: The spread of misinformation by leadership has contributed to lower vaccination rates.
options.D: Medical professionals have stopped recommending vaccines due to political pressure.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。第五段提到批評者認為衛生部長對 MMR 疫苗散布錯誤資訊，導致公眾信任度下降，進而造成疫苗接種率下滑。這推論出領導層的言論與疫情擴散有直接關聯。選項 A 與文意相反，信任度並未提升。選項 B 錯誤，文章提到疫苗的重要性與衛生設施相當，但並未說疫情是因缺乏衛生設施引起。選項 D 錯誤，文中提到醫療專業人員仍致力於控制病毒，並未停止推薦疫苗。

quiz.question: In the third paragraph, what does the phrase 'runaway epidemic' imply about the measles situation?

options.A: The disease is spreading rapidly and is difficult to control.
options.B: The outbreak is moving quickly from one state to another.
options.C: The government has successfully forced the virus to retreat.
options.D: The number of cases has reached a stable, predictable level.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在文中，「runaway」形容疫情失控，意指傳播速度過快且難以抑制。選項 B 雖然提到傳播，但「runaway」強調的是失控狀態而非地理移動。選項 C 與文意完全相反，疫情並未被控制。選項 D 錯誤，「runaway」暗示的是不穩定且爆發性的成長，而非達到穩定狀態。此詞彙在此處生動地描述了疫情惡化的嚴重程度。

quiz.question: What is the central message of this article regarding the loss of measles-free status?

options.A: The US government is imposing strict new penalties to punish unvaccinated citizens.
options.B: The loss of status is a symbolic event with no real-world consequences for public health.
options.C: The US must prioritize political resignations to regain its international standing.
options.D: The status loss is a serious warning that necessitates a renewed effort to improve vaccination coverage.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。文章整體主旨在於說明美國失去無麻疹地位的背景、原因以及未來的應對方向。最後一段總結提到，這是一個「警鐘」（wake-up call），重點在於透過改善溝通與增加疫苗取得管道來重新獲得該地位。選項 A 錯誤，文中提到沒有官方處罰。選項 B 錯誤，這並非單純的象徵性事件，而是嚴重的公共衛生挑戰。選項 C 錯誤，政治爭議只是文章的一部分，並非解決疫情的核心主旨。
